text:
noelle: Heads-up — LatticeFlux (acct LF-210) INV-2026-011 is 38 days past due. CFO responded to dunning: "we're waiting on bridge financing, can you give 90-day extension or accept a promissory note + partial payment?" cc @ryan @sana

ryan: any usage disputes or system mismatches? ledger shows $54,600 outstanding.

sana: CS on the call with CFO — they proposed 10% immediate payment, signed promissory note for the rest due in 90 days. also asked to keep API keys active.

omkar: Finance view: cautious. we can accept a promissory note plus partial payment but need safeguards: 1) 10% upfront in 5 business days, 2) signed promissory note on company letterhead, 3) board-signed proof of bridge if available, 4) continue reminder cadence. waive late fees only if note + payment received.

noelle: draft terms I propose:
```
INV-2026-011 total: $54,600
Bridge payment (10%): $5,460 due within 5 business days of signed PN
Balance: $49,140 due in 90 days from PN date
Late fee: waived contingent on PN + upfront payment; reinstated on missed payment after 7-day cure window
Service: API keys remain active while PN is in effect; revert to suspension on default
```

ryan: Collections ok with PN + partial payment provided we capture a payment method and a good-faith bank confirmation of bridge timing. recommend requiring ACH token or corporate card on file as fallback.

omkar: Omkar approves conditional waiver of late fees per above. final sign-off after we see the 10% txn id and signed promissory note. also request Sales upload CFO email acceptance to #customer-docs.

billing-bot: Created invoice revision INV-2026-011.rev1 and attached promissory note template. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2026-011/rev1 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Hold placed on aggressive escalation for LF-210 while PN and upfront payment pending. Automated reminder scheduled in 6 days.

sana: CS uploaded CFO acceptance screenshot to #customer-docs and said CFO will provide signed PN within 48 hours and try to push ACH today.

omkar: once txn id posts, finance will apply payment and clear delinquency flag. Omkar to sign off on late fee waiver after verification. If PN not returned in 7 business days, hold removed and collections resumes.

noelle: I'll send PN template + revised invoice to CFO now, set 5-business-day deadline for the 10% payment. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
